name: Returning Home
summary: Night elf priests in Ironforge are called back to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. A Sisterhood emissary seeks out acolytes abroad and sends them to Priestess Alathea for urgent training and sacred duties.

sections.title: Summoned from the Mountain City
sections.body: In Ironforge, night elf priests remain tied to the Sisterhood of Elune, though they are far from Teldrassil. Braenna Flintcrag, a dwarven priest trainer in the Mystic Ward, carries a message from a visiting night elf priestess. The messenger sought young disciples traveling abroad and said their mentors needed them back in the capital at once.

sections.title: The Temple of the Moon
sections.body: At the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, returning acolytes report to Priestess Alathea. Beneath the watchful gaze of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, Alathea welcomes her student and is relieved they crossed the seas safely. Their return begins further devotion and sacred duties, including the Stars of Elune.

faq.answer: Braenna Flintcrag, the dwarf priest trainer in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, gives the summons.

faq.q: Who do I report to in Darnassus?
aliases: where to turn in returning home
faq.answer: Report to Priestess Alathea inside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why is the Sisterhood calling priests back?
faq.answer: The Sisterhood of Elune recalls its acolytes from abroad for advanced training and sacred rites such as the Stars of Elune.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other classes?
faq.answer: No. The summons is for night elf priests who have traveled to Dun Morogh and Ironforge early in their travels.

faq.q: What happens after turning in this quest?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea welcomes you back to Darnassus and offers the Stars of Elune, which teaches more of the goddess's ways.

faq.q: How does Braenna know to look for you?
faq.answer: A priestess from the Temple of the Moon came through Ironforge seeking acolytes. She left instructions with local trainers such as Braenna to send wandering night elves home.

angles.text: As a priest, you travel from early adventures among Alliance allies back to the night elf priesthood's spiritual home at the Temple of the Moon.
As a night elf, you make a rare journey from Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms, while Elune's guidance and Tyrande's priesthood reach across the Great Sea.
As an Alliance adventurer, you see dwarven clerics in Ironforge and the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus coordinating to aid travelers.
